title: Only 7% Pass This Word Association Test
summary: Ten words. Four possible connections each. Only the sharpest minds spot every true match.

landing.intro: Each word has one correct match. The first few seem obvious - then it gets surprisingly tricky.

about.body:
Every word carries a web of possible meanings, but only one option in each round has the precise connection the question is testing. This ten-question challenge moves from familiar everyday links into science, concepts and wordplay.

Choose the strongest match from four possibilities. Correctness stays hidden until the final reveal, so instinct and careful reasoning both matter.

The quiz uses the single-keyword association format of the linked Times of India challenge as inspiration, with an original question set, answer order and result experience.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Read the keyword and decide what it connects to most precisely.
Choose one answer from the four possible matches.
Reveal your final score, then unlock every answer you missed.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This quiz measures performance on these ten associations, not intelligence or cognitive ability.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your ten connections have been checked and your word-association score is ready to reveal.

profile-1.title: The Master Connector
profile-1.copy: You moved from direct links to abstract wordplay without losing the thread. Almost every connection snapped into place immediately.

profile-2.title: The Association Expert
profile-2.copy: You passed a challenge that catches out most players. Your ability to separate a precise connection from a tempting distraction is exceptionally strong.

profile-3.title: The Quick-Link Thinker
profile-3.copy: Most connections clicked, even as the questions moved into less obvious territory. The complete review will show where one close alternative pulled you away.

profile-4.title: The Curious Pattern Hunter
profile-4.copy: You found several strong links, but the more exact science and language connections made this challenge surprisingly demanding.

profile-5.title: The Free Association Wildcard
profile-5.copy: Your mind found its own paths through the words. The unlocked review reveals the precise relationship each question was built around.
